rationale: All runs are limited by a port path at ss 100C; setup slack (+5.5 ns at 11.71 ns) dwarfs any margin, so repair never engages and T_eff ~ 0.2*target + d_io. With timing-driven placement d_io stays ~3.85 ns across util 21-30, density +14/+30, slew/cap margins and DELAY 3 vs AREA 2; without TD it is 5.2-6.0, and cap213 adds ~0.4 ns, likely via deeper clock/port buffering. Hold, electrical and DRC are clean everywhere. So keep period_frac 0.45 and the r1-1 recipe and test two untested levers: (1) r1-2's DELAY 4 + ABC-buffering netlist without cap213 (implied d_io ~3.82); (2) stock LEF RC, the lowest assumed wire cap, for a possibly shallower clock/port buffer tree.
